people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Lazarus
people.line: Poor man in Jesus' parable of the rich man

translations.web: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
translations.bsb: In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham from afar, with Lazarus by his side.
translations.kjv: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
translations.asv: And in Hades he lifted up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
